description: For empty input, the specified quotient-plus-default carrier has exactly one element, even in a language without constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.empty_carrier_card.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] :
  Nat.card
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem)
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.emptyProblem.equations ⋯) =
    1
